title: Dúha nad riekou
topic: a rainy Saturday, colours and a rainbow

sentences.sk: Je sobota ráno a v Bratislave prší.
sentences.en: It is Saturday morning and it is raining in Bratislava.

sentences.sk: Obloha je sivá a na ulici nikto nie je.
sentences.en: The sky is grey and there is nobody in the street.

sentences.sk: Oci, aké je dnes počasie?
sentences.en: Dad, what is the weather like today?

sentences.sk: Škaredé. Fúka studený vietor a padá dážď.
sentences.en: Nasty. A cold wind is blowing and rain is falling.

sentences.sk: Ale ja chcem ísť do parku!
sentences.en: But I want to go to the park!

sentences.sk: Dobre, ale oblečieš si červenú bundu a žlté čižmy.
sentences.en: All right, but you will put on your red jacket and your yellow boots.

sentences.sk: Katka si zoberie aj modrý dáždnik.
sentences.en: Katka takes the blue umbrella too.

sentences.sk: V parku je tráva mokrá a zelená.
sentences.en: In the park the grass is wet and green.

sentences.sk: Pozri, oci, tá kaluž je veľká ako more!
sentences.en: Look, Dad, that puddle is as big as the sea!

sentences.sk: Katka skáče do kaluže a smeje sa.
sentences.en: Katka jumps into the puddle and laughs.

sentences.sk: Potom dážď prestane a spoza mraku vyjde slnko.
sentences.en: Then the rain stops and the sun comes out from behind a cloud.

sentences.sk: Zrazu je obloha zase modrá.
sentences.en: Suddenly the sky is blue again.

sentences.sk: Katka, pozri hore! Nad riekou je dúha.
sentences.en: Katka, look up! There is a rainbow over the river.

sentences.sk: Aké farby má dúha?
sentences.en: What colours does a rainbow have?

sentences.sk: Červenú, oranžovú, žltú, zelenú, modrú a fialovú.
sentences.en: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.

sentences.sk: Moja bunda je červená ako dúha!
sentences.en: My jacket is red like the rainbow!

sentences.sk: Na lavičke sedí starý pán s čiernym psom.
sentences.en: An old man with a black dog is sitting on a bench.

sentences.sk: Hovorí, že po daždi vždy príde slnko.
sentences.en: He says that after rain the sun always comes.

sentences.sk: Večer je teplo a obloha je ružová.
sentences.en: In the evening it is warm and the sky is pink.

sentences.sk: Oci, bude zajtra zase pršať?
sentences.en: Dad, will it rain again tomorrow?

sentences.sk: Neviem. Ale máš žlté čižmy, tak sa nemusíš báť.
sentences.en: I don't know. But you have yellow boots, so you don't need to be afraid.

sentences.sk: Ja sa nebojím. Chcem ďalšiu dúhu!
sentences.en: I'm not afraid. I want another rainbow!

questions.q: Čo vidia Katka a otec nad riekou?

recap: On a rainy Saturday Katka goes to the park with her dad in a red jacket and yellow boots. The rain stops, a rainbow appears over the river, and Katka wants another one.
